seo.title: Oakland Homeless Help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified practical resources for people experiencing homelessness in Oakland.

page.heading: OAKLAND - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger: 911. Shelter and service referrals: 211. Crisis support: call or text 988.
page.notice: Availability, eligibility, hours, and capacity can change. Call ahead when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, job, or legal representation.
page.intro: Call 211 for current shelter referrals and outreach. Shelters may require referral and may be full.
page.footer: Information can change. Call ahead when possible and report incorrect information through the GitHub link in the footer.

entries.title: Emergency services — 911
entries.description: For immediate danger, fire, a life-threatening medical emergency, or violence.
entries.how_to_access: Give the exact location and explain what is happening.

entries.title: 2-1-1 Alameda County
entries.description: Free referrals for shelter, food, health, benefits, and other services.
entries.how_to_access: Dial 211 and explain your current needs.

entries.title: St. Vincent de Paul emergency shelter
entries.description: Overnight shelter serving eligible Oakland and Emeryville residents. Space and intake rules can change.
entries.how_to_access: Call 211 or the provider about current referral and intake.

entries.title: St. Vincent de Paul Community Center — hot meal
entries.description: Free hot meal and day services. Meal times can change.
entries.how_to_access: Call or arrive during current center hours.

entries.title: St. Vincent de Paul of Alameda County
entries.description: Catholic charity with shelter, meals, clothing, hygiene, wellness, and referrals.

entries.title: St. Vincent de Paul — showers and laundry
entries.description: Community-center showers, laundry, and hygiene support; capacity varies.
entries.how_to_access: Arrive early and ask about sign-up.

entries.title: St. Vincent de Paul — clothing
entries.description: Free clothing may be available; stock and schedules vary.

entries.title: St. Vincent de Paul — wellness services
entries.description: The center lists wellness and health support; clinic availability changes.
entries.how_to_access: Ask when health services are available.

entries.title: St. Vincent de Paul Community Center
entries.description: Day services with meals, hygiene, clothing, wellness, and referrals.

entries.title: Alameda County Social Services
entries.description: Apply for CalFresh and get information about Medi-Cal and General Assistance.
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or contact the county.

entries.title: Oakland Private Industry Council
entries.description: Job search, training, career guidance, and employer connections.

entries.title: Bay Area Legal Aid
entries.description: Free civil legal help for eligible low-income residents.
entries.how_to_access: Call the advice line for screening.

entries.title: National Domestic Violence Hotline
entries.description: Confidential safety planning and local referrals.
entries.how_to_access: Call, text START to 88788, or use chat when safe.

entries.title: National Call Center for Homeless Veterans
entries.description: Connects veterans who are homeless or at risk with VA services and local resources.
entries.how_to_access: Call and say you are a veteran who is homeless or at risk of losing housing.
